headlines.headline: KNICKS REACH NBA FINALS FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 1999; AWAIT THUNDER-SPURS GAME 7
headlines.detail: New York swept Cleveland 4-0 in the ECF, with Jalen Brunson earning ECF MVP. NBA Finals tip June 3 on ABC.

headlines.headline: SEAHAWKS FRANCHISE SALE COULD ECLIPSE $10 BILLION, CLOSE BEFORE 2026 SEASON
headlines.detail: Market has 'picked up steam' per Rapoport. Bidders include Grousbeck-Mittal and Vinod Khosla groups.

headlines.headline: WASHINGTON WRAPS SPRING BALL; DEFENSE SHINES IN DAWGS AFTER DARK GAME
headlines.detail: Purple beat Gold 27-10 at Husky Stadium. Devin Hyde and Xe'Ree Alexander led the defense.

headlines.headline: MICHIGAN'S DUSTY MAY SIGNS FIVE-YEAR EXTENSION AFTER NATIONAL TITLE
headlines.detail: May locked in through 2030-31 after Michigan's 69-63 title win over UConn. Tournament expanding to 76 teams.
